About Joyce Ndehi & Company Advocates

YOUR TRUSTED LEGAL PARTNER IN KIAMBU

Dedicated legal counsel. Personal attention.

Joyce Ndehi & Company Advocates provides professional legal guidance for individuals, families and businesses in Kiambu and beyond.

We offer counsel and representation in mediation, succession and probate, property transactions, commercial matters, data protection, and dispute resolution. We listen carefully, explain your options clearly, and work towards practical outcomes.
